reason: HyperHug fails Ben Cole's ICP on four independent axes: it is HQ'd in Limassol, Cyprus (HYPERHUG LTD, reg. HE 403878) rather than US-based; it is a mobile free-to-play developer/publisher shipping to the App Store and Google Play (Oxide: Survival Island, Slice Masters, Clash of Smiles) rather than a PC/console studio; Tracxn and Uplers both list it as unfunded/self-funded with no external investment and it self-publishes, so there is no publisher relationship or funding tranche and therefore no publisher-fixed milestone date -- the exact EDP Ben sells against; and its flagship title launched in 2021 with 100M+ players, meaning it is a live-ops business, not a studio 'entering full production.' The Lead DevOps Engineer posting does carry a real ownership-gap line ('Own the DevOps/SRE function end-to-end -- build and scale the team from scratch'), but the surrounding job is high-load mobile SRE, DDoS mitigation and 24/7 on-call for a shipped live game, which is a permanent in-house hire at a ~19-27 person bootstrapped Cyprus company, not a fractional US technical-operations engagement protecting milestone confidence.
